| Property                       | Description                                                           |
| -------------------------------| --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| GUID                           | The GUID associated to the customerhomecache                          |
| CustomerId                     | Value associated to the customer id                                   |
| CustomerSites                  | Number of sites associated to the customer                            |
| ServiceAgreements              | Number of Service aggreements associated to the customer              |
| InvoiceableWork                | Amount of invoiceable works                                           |
| Rentals                        | Number of rentals                                                     |
| AgedDebt0To30                  | Aged debt associated to the customer between 0 to 30 days             |
| AgedDebt30To60                 | Aged debt associated to the customer between 30 to 60 days            |
| AgedDebt60To90                 | Aged debt associated to the customer between 60 to 90 days            |
| AgedDebt90Plus                 | Aged debt associated to the customer above 90 days                    |
| OutstandingAmount              | Outstanding amount associated to the customer                         |
| UnallocatedAmount              | Unallocated amount associated to the customer                         |
| Balance                        | Balance amount available                                              |
| UnconfirmedBalance             | Unconfirmed balance amount associated to the customer                 |
| APInvoice                      | Amount in APInvoice                                                   |
| POInvoice                      | Amount in POInvoice                                                   |
| PONumbers                      | Number of PO's                                                        |
| Communications                 | Number of communications                                              |
| CommunicationsWithDocuments    | Number of communications with documents                               |
| PortalReportsCount             | Count of reports                                                      |
| CreditLimit                    | Credit limit amount                                                   |
| CacheDate                      | Data cached date                                                      |
| AdvanceDeposit                 | Amount of deposit done in advance                                     |
| PrePayment                     | Amount of prepayment done                                             |
| RemainingCredit                | Total amount of remaining credit                                      |
